segments.en: In a midterm election, it's hard to keep track of all those small down ballot races. So some voters are using AI chatbots to figure out who to support.

segments.speaker: Host

segments.en: Sometimes if you push back to hallucinations, the chatbot will confess that it made something up. But in other cases, you know, it will double down.
segments.ko: 가끔 환각 현상에 대해 반박하면 챗봇은 자신이 무언가를 지어냈다고 고백하기도 합니다. 하지만 다른 경우에는, 아시다시피, 자신의 주장을 굽히지 않고 밀어붙이기도 하죠.
segments.speaker: Host

segments.en: What you should know about using AI for election research. Listen now on the NPR Politics podcast.
